'''Maton-Ja''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the co-leader of the [[Shrine Restoration Initiative]], an organization created to rebuild the shrines and temples of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] following the [[Invasion of Voss]]. As the representative of his species, he sought to preserve Voss history.<ref name="TOR" />
